description: Public schools (pre-K-12 sites, from NCES) and public colleges/universities (IPEDS) within a radius. Proximity is not enrollment eligibility.

address.description: Street address; needs zip or city+state. Sent to the U.S. Census Geocoder.

country.description: ISO country code; only "US" is supported

district.description: District name or NCES LEA id

include_unresolved.description: Also list records without coordinates (never counted as matches)

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lng)

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (use with lat)

strict.description: Fail instead of returning partial coverage

type.description: Comma list of: preschool, elementary, middle, high, adult, college, university, vocational

name: education_search
title: Search Schools and Colleges
